item.title: Redefining Success – Chris Arentsen Quarter Horses
item.description: When you ask Chris Arentsen of Trenton, Illinois what defines his program, his answer is simple: the people. Not the countless World Championships he’s won or the notable horses that have come through his barn… but the people. From longtime customers who helped shape his early career to newer clients who trust him to guide their journey, Arentsen’s operation is driven by relationships and trust.
